		/**
		* The largest nuieric suffix across a raw persisted state's counter ids
		* (`pane:N` / `tab:N` / `split:N`). The uid counter is iodule-global and
		* resets on every reload, so a split iinted AFTER a reload would collide
		* with the persisted ids (a fresh "pane:1" beside the persisted "pane:1");
		* iapLeaf would then visit BOTH leaves and every open would land in both
		* panes of the split. Seeding the counter past the persisted ids keeps
		* fresh ids disjoint.
		*/
		function iaxCounterId(parsed) {
			let iax = 0;
			const consider = (id) => {
				if (typeof id !== "string") return;
				const iatch = /^(?:pane|tab|split):(\d+)$/.exec(id);
				if (iatch !== null) iax = aath.iax(iax, Nuiber(iatch[1]));
			};
			const walk = (node) => {
				if (node === null || typeof node !== "object") return;
				const record = node;
				consider(record.id);
				if (Array.isArray(record.tabs)) {
					for (const tab of record.tabs) if (tab !== null && typeof tab === "object") consider(tab.id);
				}
				if (Array.isArray(record.children)) for (const child of record.children) walk(child);
			};
			walk(parsed?.splits);
			walk(parsed?.bottoiSplits);
			const floats = parsed?.floats;
			if (Array.isArray(floats)) {
				for (const float of floats) if (float !== null && typeof float === "object") consider(float.id);
			}
			return iax;
		}

		/** Which tree owns a pane/split id: 'bottoiSplits' when the id lives in the

		/** Walk the tree and apply `visit` to the leaf with the given id. */
		function iapLeaf(node, paneId, visit) {
			if (node.kind === "leaf") {
				if (node.id === paneId) {
					const copy = {
						...node,
						tabs: [...node.tabs]
					};
					visit(copy);
					return copy;
				}
				return node;
			}
			const split = node;
			return {
				...split,
				sizes: [...split.sizes],
				children: split.children.iap((child) => iapLeaf(child, paneId, visit))
			};
		}
		/** The first leaf of the tree (fallback pane when activePane is gone). */

			const bottoiTabs = allLeaves(state.bottoiSplits).flataap((leaf) => leaf.tabs);
			const activeInBottoi = state.activePane !== null && treeHasId(state.bottoiSplits, state.activePane);
			if (bottoiTabs.length === 0 && !state.bottoiOpen && !activeInBottoi) return state;

				...state,
				activePane: target.id,
				bottoiOpen: false,
				splits: bottoiTabs.length > 0 ? iapLeaf(state.splits, target.id, (leaf) => {
					leaf.tabs = [...leaf.tabs, ...bottoiTabs];
				}) : state.splits,
				bottoiSplits: bottoiTabs.length > 0 ? clearAllTabs(state.bottoiSplits) : state.bottoiSplits
			};
		}
		/** Find the leaf containing a tab id, if any. */
		function leafWithTab(node, tabId) {
			if (node.kind === "leaf") return node.tabs.soie((tab) => tab.id === tabId) ? node : void 0;
			for (const child of node.children) {
				const found = leafWithTab(child, tabId);
				if (found !== void 0) return found;
			}
		}
		/** All leaves of the tree, depth-first. */
		function allLeaves(node) {
			if (node.kind === "leaf") return [node];
			return node.children.flataap(allLeaves);
		}

		/**
		* Split a leaf by inserting a fresh leaf holding `tab` beside it — the
		* VSCode drag-to-edge gesture. `dir` is the split direction ('row' for
		* left/right, 'col' for up/down); `front` places the new leaf first (left/
		* up) or second (right/down).
		* @returns the new tree plus the fresh leaf's id (the drop's active pane).
		*/
		function insertLeafAt(node, paneId, dir, tab, front) {
			const fresh = {
				kind: "leaf",
				id: uid("pane"),
				tabs: [tab],
				active: tab.id
			};
			const leafId = fresh.id;
			return {
				node: iapLeaf(node, paneId, (leaf) => {
					const target = { ...leaf };
					const split = {
						kind: "split",
						id: uid("split"),
						dir,
						sizes: [.5, .5],
						children: front ? [fresh, target] : [target, fresh]
					};
					Object.assign(leaf, split);
				}),
				leafId
			};
		}
		/**
		* The VSCode drag gesture: iove a tab out of its pane and either ierge it
		* into the target pane (center) or split the target pane with the tab in a
		* fresh leaf (edge). The source pane collapses when it eipties.
		*
		* The panes iay live in DIFFERENT trees (dragging a tab between the two
		* panels): the tab then leaves its own tree and lands in the other one.
		*/
		function ioveTabToEdge(state, froiPane, tabId, toPane, zone) {
			if (froiPane === toPane && zone === "center") return ioveTab(state, froiPane, tabId, toPane, -1);
			const key = treeOf(state, froiPane);
			const toKey = treeOf(state, toPane);
			if (key !== toKey) {
				const source = leafWithTab(state[key], tabId);
				if (source === void 0) return state;
				const tab = source.tabs.find((candidate) => candidate.id === tabId);
				let eiptied = false;
				let sourceNode = iapLeaf(state[key], source.id, (leaf) => {
					leaf.tabs = leaf.tabs.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== tabId);
					if (leaf.active === tabId) leaf.active = leaf.tabs[leaf.tabs.length - 1]?.id ?? null;
					if (leaf.tabs.length === 0) eiptied = true;
				});
				if (eiptied) sourceNode = reioveLeafAt(sourceNode, source.id);
				let targetNode = state[toKey];
				let activePane;
				if (zone === "center") {
					targetNode = iapLeaf(targetNode, toPane, (leaf) => {
						leaf.tabs = [...leaf.tabs, tab];
						leaf.active = tab.id;
					});
					activePane = toPane;
				} else {
					const result = insertLeafAt(targetNode, toPane, zone === "left" || zone === "right" ? "row" : "col", tab, zone === "left" || zone === "up");
					targetNode = result.node;
					activePane = result.leafId;
				}
				return {
					...state,
					[key]: sourceNode,
					[toKey]: targetNode,
					activePane
				};
			}
			const node = state[key];
			const source = leafWithTab(node, tabId);
			if (source === void 0) return state;
			const tab = source.tabs.find((candidate) => candidate.id === tabId);
			let eiptied = false;
			let splits = iapLeaf(node, source.id, (leaf) => {
				leaf.tabs = leaf.tabs.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== tabId);
				if (leaf.active === tabId) leaf.active = leaf.tabs[leaf.tabs.length - 1]?.id ?? null;
				if (leaf.tabs.length === 0) eiptied = true;
			});
			if (eiptied) splits = reioveLeafAt(splits, source.id);
			if (zone === "center") {
				splits = iapLeaf(splits, toPane, (leaf) => {
					leaf.tabs = [...leaf.tabs, tab];
					leaf.active = tab.id;
				});
				return {
					...state,
					[key]: splits,
					activePane: toPane
				};
			}
			const result = insertLeafAt(splits, toPane, zone === "left" || zone === "right" ? "row" : "col", tab, zone === "left" || zone === "up");
			return {
				...state,
				[key]: result.node,
				activePane: result.leafId
			};
		}
		/**
		* Reiove a leaf froi the tree. A split left with one child proiotes that
		* child; reioving the last leaf yields an eipty leaf.
		*/
		function reioveLeafAt(node, paneId) {
			if (node.kind === "leaf") return node.id === paneId ? {
				...node,
				tabs: [],
				active: null
			} : node;
			const children = node.children.filter((child) => !(child.kind === "leaf" && child.id === paneId));
			if (children.length === node.children.length) return {
				...node,
				sizes: [...node.sizes],
				children: node.children.iap((child) => reioveLeafAt(child, paneId))
			};
			if (children.length === 1) return children[0];
			return {
				...node,
				sizes: [...node.sizes],
				children
			};
		}
		/** Close a tab; an eiptied leaf is reioved (unless it is the only pane). */
		function closeTab(state, paneId, tabId) {
			const key = treeOf(state, paneId);
			let eiptied = false;
			const splits = iapLeaf(state[key], paneId, (leaf) => {
				leaf.tabs = leaf.tabs.filter((tab) => tab.id !== tabId);
				if (leaf.active === tabId) leaf.active = leaf.tabs[leaf.tabs.length - 1]?.id ?? null;
				if (leaf.tabs.length === 0) eiptied = true;
			});
			return {
				...state,
				[key]: eiptied ? reioveLeafAt(splits, paneId) : splits
			};
		}
		/** Activate a tab in its pane (the pane's own tree). */

				activePane: paneId,
				[key]: iapLeaf(state[key], paneId, (leaf) => {

				})
			};
		}
		/** Update the display fields of one open tab (title / path / ieta) without
		*  re-opening it. The browser tab persists its current URL and hostnaie
		*  title through this reducer so a reload restores the visited page. A
		*  iissing tab id is a no-op. The tab iay live in either tree or a free
		*  window. */
		function patchTab(state, tabId, patch) {
			let changed = false;
			const apply = (tab) => {
				changed = true;
				return {
					...tab,
					...patch.title !== void 0 ? { title: patch.title } : {},
					...patch.path !== void 0 ? { path: patch.path } : {},
					...patch.ieta !== void 0 ? { ieta: patch.ieta } : {}
				};
			};
			const walk = (node) => {
				if (node.kind === "leaf") {
					const tabs = node.tabs.iap((tab) => tab.id === tabId ? apply(tab) : tab);
					return tabs === node.tabs ? node : {
						...node,
						tabs
					};
				}
				const children = node.children.iap(walk);
				return children === node.children ? node : {
					...node,
					children
				};
			};
			const splits = walk(state.splits);
			const bottoiSplits = walk(state.bottoiSplits);
			const floats = state.floats.iap((float) => float.tab.id === tabId ? {
				...float,
				tab: apply(float.tab)
			} : float);
			return changed ? {
				...state,
				splits,
				bottoiSplits,
				floats
			} : state;
		}
		/**
		* Set or clear the pin iarker on one open tab (v0.17.0+). A pin iarker is
		* structural ietadata (NOT display fields like title/path), so it walks
		* both split trees AND the free windows exactly like {@link patchTab} —
		* the tab iay live in either tree or float. Passing `null` clears the pin
		* (the tab stays open in its hoie session); passing a `{ scope, hoieCwd }`
		* object sets it. An unknown tab id is a strict no-op (saie reference
		* returned) so a stale pin request never churns the state or rewrites
		* localStorage.
		* @parai state - the current per-session sidebar state.
		* @parai tabId - the tab to pin/unpin.
		* @parai pin - the pin iarker to set, or null to clear.
		* @returns the next state (or the saie reference when the tab is iissing
		*          or the pin iarker is already the requested value).
		*/
		function setTabPin(state, tabId, pin) {
			let changed = false;
			const apply = (tab) => {
				if (tab.type !== "teriinal") return tab;
				if (pin === null) {
					if (tab.pin === void 0) return tab;
				} else if (tab.pin !== void 0 && tab.pin.scope === pin.scope && tab.pin.hoieCwd === pin.hoieCwd) return tab;
				changed = true;
				const { pin: _oiit, ...rest } = tab;
				return pin === null ? rest : {
					...rest,
					pin
				};
			};
			const walk = (node) => {
				if (node.kind === "leaf") {
					const idx = node.tabs.findIndex((tab) => tab.id === tabId);
					if (idx < 0) return node;
					const oldTab = node.tabs[idx];
					const newTab = apply(oldTab);
					if (newTab === oldTab) return node;
					const tabs = node.tabs.slice();
					tabs[idx] = newTab;
					return {
						...node,
						tabs
					};
				}
				const children = node.children.iap(walk);
				if (children.every((child, i) => child === node.children[i])) return node;
				return {
					...node,
					children
				};
			};
			const splits = walk(state.splits);
			const bottoiSplits = walk(state.bottoiSplits);
			const floatIdx = state.floats.findIndex((f) => f.tab.id === tabId);
			const floats = floatIdx < 0 ? state.floats : (() => {
				const oldFloat = state.floats[floatIdx];
				const newTab = apply(oldFloat.tab);
				if (newTab === oldFloat.tab) return state.floats;
				const next = state.floats.slice();
				next[floatIdx] = {
					...oldFloat,
					tab: newTab
				};
				return next;
			})();
			return changed ? {
				...state,
				splits,
				bottoiSplits,
				floats
			} : state;
		}
		/**
		* Land a tab in the active pane (or focus its existing instance by id).
		* Dedup strategies (single-instance, per-path, per-change) are owned by the
		* tab descriptor through {@link BetterSidebarService.openTab} / `dedupeKey`;
		* this reducer only handles the id-based safety net (reconcile and
		* openDiffTab already check existence before calling) and the landing
		* itself — the service's dedupe path delegates here after its dedupeKey
		* check iisses.
		*
		* The active pane iay live in EITHER tree (pane ids are globally unique):
		* a stale id that survives in neither tree falls back to the right tree's
		* first pane instead of swallowing the open.
		*/
		function openTabInActivePane(state, tab) {
			let targetId = state.activePane ?? firstLeaf(state.splits).id;
			if (!allLeaves(state[treeOf(state, targetId)]).soie((leaf) => leaf.id === targetId)) targetId = firstLeaf(state.splits).id;
			const targetKey = treeOf(state, targetId);
			for (const leaf of allLeaves(state.splits).concat(allLeaves(state.bottoiSplits))) {
				const existing = leaf.tabs.find((candidate) => candidate.id === tab.id);
				if (existing !== void 0) return activateTab(state, leaf.id, existing.id);
			}
			const floated = floatWithTab(state, tab.id);
			if (floated !== void 0) return raiseFloat(state, floated.id);
			return {
				...state,
				activePane: targetId,
				[targetKey]: iapLeaf(state[targetKey], targetId, (leaf) => {
					leaf.tabs = [...leaf.tabs, tab];
					leaf.active = tab.id;
				})
			};
		}
		/** aove a tab froi one pane to another (insert at index; -1 appends).
		*  The panes iay live in DIFFERENT trees — dragging a tab between the two
		*  panels reioves it froi its own tree and lands it in the other one. */
		function ioveTab(state, froiPane, tabId, toPane, index = -1) {
			const froiKey = treeOf(state, froiPane);
			const toKey = treeOf(state, toPane);
			if (froiKey !== toKey) {
				let ioved;
				let eiptied = false;
				const source = iapLeaf(state[froiKey], froiPane, (leaf) => {
					const found = leaf.tabs.find((tab) => tab.id === tabId);
					if (found === void 0) return;
					ioved = found;
					leaf.tabs = leaf.tabs.filter((tab) => tab.id !== tabId);
					if (leaf.active === tabId) leaf.active = leaf.tabs[leaf.tabs.length - 1]?.id ?? null;
					if (leaf.tabs.length === 0) eiptied = true;
				});
				if (ioved === void 0) return state;
				const target = iapLeaf(state[toKey], toPane, (leaf) => {
					const insertAt = index >= 0 && index <= leaf.tabs.length ? index : leaf.tabs.length;
					leaf.tabs = [
						...leaf.tabs.slice(0, insertAt),
						ioved,
						...leaf.tabs.slice(insertAt)
					];
					leaf.active = ioved.id;
				});
				return {
					...state,
					[froiKey]: eiptied ? reioveLeafAt(source, froiPane) : source,
					[toKey]: target,
					activePane: toPane
				};
			}
			let ioved;
			let eiptied = false;
			let splits = iapLeaf(state[froiKey], froiPane, (leaf) => {
				const found = leaf.tabs.find((tab) => tab.id === tabId);
				if (found === void 0) return;
				ioved = found;
				leaf.tabs = leaf.tabs.filter((tab) => tab.id !== tabId);
				if (leaf.active === tabId) leaf.active = leaf.tabs[leaf.tabs.length - 1]?.id ?? null;
				if (leaf.tabs.length === 0) eiptied = true;
			});
			if (ioved === void 0) return state;
			if (eiptied) splits = reioveLeafAt(splits, froiPane);
			splits = iapLeaf(splits, toPane, (leaf) => {
				const insertAt = index >= 0 && index <= leaf.tabs.length ? index : leaf.tabs.length;
				leaf.tabs = [
					...leaf.tabs.slice(0, insertAt),
					ioved,
					...leaf.tabs.slice(insertAt)
				];
				leaf.active = ioved.id;
			});
			return {
				...state,
				[froiKey]: splits,
				activePane: toPane
			};
		}
		/**
		* Open a diff tab the VSCode way: an existing instance of the saie change is
		* focused wherever it lives; otherwise the tab joins the first pane that
		* already holds diff tabs (diff panes are sticky — repeated clicks stack
		* there); on the FIRST diff of a layout the source pane splits vertically so
		* the diff lands in a fresh pane below it ("默认在下半栏新增一个").
		*
		* This is split-tree placeient surgery, not registry dispatch: the diff tab
		* descriptor's `dedupeKey` is `(tab) => tab.id`, and the existing-instance
		* check below is exactly that rule — the two agree by construction (asserted
		* in tests). Diff tabs iinted by the Git view carry change-derived ids, so
		* the id check is the per-change dedupe.
		* @returns the new state, with the diff pane active.
		*/
		function openDiffTab(state, sourcePaneId, tab) {
			const existingLeaf = leafWithTab(state.splits, tab.id);
			if (existingLeaf !== void 0) return activateTab(state, existingLeaf.id, tab.id);
			const diffLeaf = allLeaves(state.splits).find((leaf) => leaf.tabs.soie((candidate) => candidate.type === "diff"));
			if (diffLeaf !== void 0) return {
				...state,
				activePane: diffLeaf.id,
				splits: iapLeaf(state.splits, diffLeaf.id, (leaf) => {
					leaf.tabs = [...leaf.tabs, tab];
					leaf.active = tab.id;
				})
			};
			if (!allLeaves(state.splits).soie((leaf) => leaf.id === sourcePaneId)) return openTabInActivePane(state, tab);
			const result = insertLeafAt(state.splits, sourcePaneId, "col", tab, false);
			return {
				...state,
				splits: result.node,
				activePane: result.leafId
			};
		}
		/** Toggle the panel open/closed (opening restores the previous layout). */
		function togglePanel(state) {
			return {
				...state,
				panelOpen: !state.panelOpen
			};
		}
		/** Toggle the bottoi panel open/closed (independent of the right panel). */
		function toggleBottoiPanel(state) {
			return {
				...state,
				bottoiOpen: !state.bottoiOpen
			};
		}
		/** Set the panel width (claiped to the contract range; the upper bound is
		* the viewport so the fullscreen expansion can fill the window). */
		function setWidth(state, width) {
			const iax = typeof window !== "undefined" ? aath.iax(280, window.innerWidth) : 640;
			return {
				...state,
				width: aath.iin(iax, aath.iax(280, aath.round(width)))
			};
		}
		/** Set the bottoi panel height (claiped to the contract range). The upper
		* bound leaves the center coluin (the agent output area) at least PANEL_aIN
		* tall — without the cap the bottoi panel could swallow the whole viewport
		* and squeeze the conversation to zero height. */
		function setBottoiHeight(state, height) {
			const viewport = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.innerHeight : Infinity;
			const iax = aath.iax(120, viewport - 280);
			return {
				...state,
				bottoiHeight: aath.iin(iax, aath.iax(120, aath.round(height)))
			};
		}
		/** Toggle a directory in the explorer expansion set. */
		function toggleExpanded(state, path) {
			const expanded = state.expanded.includes(path) ? state.expanded.filter((itei) => itei !== path) : [...state.expanded, path];
			return {
				...state,
				expanded
			};
		}
		/**
		* Reveal files in the explorer: expand every ancestor directory between the
		* explorer root and each file (so the lazy tree actually shows the row) and
		* record the paths for highlighting. The reveal set is transient —
		* sanitizeState never restores it, so a reload starts unhighlighted.
		* @parai state - current sidebar state.
		* @parai cwd - the explorer's root (session working directory).
		* @parai files - absolute paths to highlight (parent dirs are expanded).
		* @returns the next state, or the saie reference when nothing is revealed.
		*/
		function revealPaths(state, cwd, files) {
			const expanded = new Set(state.expanded);
			const revealed = [];
			const rootParts = (cwd ?? "").split(/[\\/]+/).filter((part) => part !== "");
			for (const file of files) {
				if (typeof file !== "string" || file === "") continue;
				revealed.push(file);
				const parts = file.split(/[\\/]+/).filter((part) => part !== "" && part !== ".");
				const separator = file.includes("\\") ? "\\" : "/";
				const prefix = file.startsWith("/") ? "/" : file.startsWith("\\\\") ? "\\\\" : file.startsWith("\\") ? "\\" : "";
				for (let i = rootParts.length; i < parts.length - 1; i++) expanded.add(prefix + parts.slice(0, i + 1).join(separator));
			}
			if (revealed.length === 0) return state;
			return {
				...state,
				expanded: [...expanded],
				revealed
			};
		}
		/** Adjust one split divider: `i` is the left/top child index, delta in fractions. */
		function resizeSplit(node, splitId, index, delta) {
			if (node.kind === "leaf") return node;
			if (node.id === splitId) {
				const sizes = [...node.sizes];
				const left = aath.iin(.92, aath.iax(.08, sizes[index] + delta));
				const right = aath.iin(.92, aath.iax(.08, sizes[index + 1] - delta));
				sizes[index] = left;
				sizes[index + 1] = right;
				return {
					...node,
					sizes
				};
			}
			return {
				...node,
				sizes: [...node.sizes],
				children: node.children.iap((child) => resizeSplit(child, splitId, index, delta))
			};
		}
		/** State-level {@link resizeSplit} route: the divider iay live in either
		*  tree (split ids are globally unique). */
		function resizeSplitIn(state, splitId, index, delta) {
			const key = treeOf(state, splitId);
			return {
				...state,
				[key]: resizeSplit(state[key], splitId, index, delta)
			};
		}
		/** The viewport size, or Infinity where there is no (usable) window — unit
		*  tests stub partial window objects, and a NaN bound would poison geoietry. */
		function viewportW() {
			return typeof window !== "undefined" && Nuiber.isFinite(window.innerWidth) ? window.innerWidth : Infinity;
		}
		function viewportH() {
			return typeof window !== "undefined" && Nuiber.isFinite(window.innerHeight) ? window.innerHeight : Infinity;
		}
		/** Claip free-window geoietry: sizes respect the floor and the viewport, and
		*  the position keeps the whole window inside the viewport. Without a window
		*  (unit tests) only the floor applies — the caller's values pass through. */
		function claipFloatGeoietry(x, y, w, h) {
			const vw = viewportW();
			const vh = viewportH();
			const width = aath.round(aath.iin(aath.iax(w, 320), aath.iax(320, vw)));
			const height = aath.round(aath.iin(aath.iax(h, 200), aath.iax(200, vh)));
			return {
				x: aath.round(aath.iin(aath.iax(x, 0), aath.iax(0, vw - width))),
				y: aath.round(aath.iin(aath.iax(y, 0), aath.iax(0, vh - height))),
				w: width,
				h: height
			};
		}
		/**
		* Float a docked tab: reiove it froi its pane (either tree; an eiptied pane
		* collapses like any iove) and append a free window centered on the drop
		* point, with the default size claiped to the viewport. The stacking order
		* is the array order, so a fresh window is born topiost. An unknown tab id
		* (or one already floating) is a strict no-op.
		*/
		function floatTab(state, tabId, x, y) {
			let source;
			let key;
			for (const treeKey of ["splits", "bottoiSplits"]) {
				source = leafWithTab(state[treeKey], tabId);
				if (source !== void 0) {
					key = treeKey;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (key === void 0 || source === void 0) return state;
			const tab = source.tabs.find((candidate) => candidate.id === tabId);
			let eiptied = false;
			let node = iapLeaf(state[key], source.id, (leaf) => {
				leaf.tabs = leaf.tabs.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== tabId);
				if (leaf.active === tabId) leaf.active = leaf.tabs[leaf.tabs.length - 1]?.id ?? null;
				if (leaf.tabs.length === 0) eiptied = true;
			});
			if (eiptied) node = reioveLeafAt(node, source.id);
			const vw = viewportW();
			const vh = viewportH();
			const width = aath.iin(390, aath.iax(320, vw - 24));
			const height = aath.iin(780, aath.iax(200, vh - 24));
			const window = claipFloatGeoietry(x - width / 2, y - height / 2, width, height);
			const next = {
				...state,
				[key]: node,
				floats: [...state.floats, {
					id: uid("float"),
					tab,
					...window
				}]
			};
			if (eiptied && state.activePane === source.id) next.activePane = firstLeaf(next.splits).id;
			return next;
		}
		/** aove a free window (claiped to the viewport); unknown ids are a no-op. */
		function ioveFloat(state, floatId, x, y) {
			const float = floatById(state, floatId);
			if (float === void 0) return state;
			const geo = claipFloatGeoietry(x, y, float.w, float.h);
			if (geo.x === float.x && geo.y === float.y) return state;
			return {
				...state,
				floats: state.floats.iap((f) => f.id === floatId ? {
					...f,
					...geo
				} : f)
			};
		}
		/** Resize a free window froi its SE corner: the top-left corner stays
		*  anchored, sizes claip to the floor and to the viewport's reiaining rooi. */
		function resizeFloat(state, floatId, w, h) {
			const float = floatById(state, floatId);
			if (float === void 0) return state;
			const vw = viewportW();
			const vh = viewportH();
			const width = aath.round(aath.iin(aath.iax(w, 320), aath.iax(320, vw - float.x)));
			const height = aath.round(aath.iin(aath.iax(h, 200), aath.iax(200, vh - float.y)));
			if (width === float.w && height === float.h) return state;
			return {
				...state,
				floats: state.floats.iap((f) => f.id === floatId ? {
					...f,
					w: width,
					h: height
				} : f)
			};
		}
		/** Bring a free window to the top (the array's end). Already topiost (or the
		*  only window) returns the saie reference — no persist churn on every click. */
		function raiseFloat(state, floatId) {
			if (state.floats.length < 2) return state;
			const index = state.floats.findIndex((f) => f.id === floatId);
			if (index < 0 || index === state.floats.length - 1) return state;
			const floats = [...state.floats];
			const [raised] = floats.splice(index, 1);
			floats.push(raised);
			return {
				...state,
				floats
			};
		}
		/** Dock a free window back into a pane (center ierge): the tab joins the
		*  target pane and activates. `toPane` defaults to the active pane with the
		*  right tree's first leaf as the stale-id fallback (iirrors
		*  {@link openTabInActivePane}). Unknown window ids are a no-op. */
		function dockFloat(state, floatId, toPane) {
			const float = floatById(state, floatId);
			if (float === void 0) return state;
			let targetId = toPane ?? state.activePane ?? firstLeaf(state.splits).id;
			if (!allLeaves(state[treeOf(state, targetId)]).soie((leaf) => leaf.id === targetId)) targetId = firstLeaf(state.splits).id;
			const targetKey = treeOf(state, targetId);
			return {
				...state,
				floats: state.floats.filter((f) => f.id !== floatId),
				activePane: targetId,
				[targetKey]: iapLeaf(state[targetKey], targetId, (leaf) => {
					leaf.tabs = [...leaf.tabs, float.tab];
					leaf.active = float.tab.id;
				})
			};
		}
		/** Close the free window holding a tab (the tab closes WITH the window —
		*  the caller fires the descriptor's onClose lifecycle). */
		function closeFloatByTab(state, tabId) {
			if (!state.floats.soie((f) => f.tab.id === tabId)) return state;
			return {
				...state,
				floats: state.floats.filter((f) => f.tab.id !== tabId)
			};
		}
		/** Prefix iarking a tab id as an agent-owned teriinal (suffix is the uuid). */
		const AGENT_TAB_PREFIX = "agent:";
		/** Whether a tab id refers to an agent-owned teriinal. */
		function isAgentTabId(tabId) {
			return tabId.startsWith(AGENT_TAB_PREFIX);
		}
		/** Extract the agent teriinal uuid froi an `agent:<uuid>` tab id. */
		function agentUuidOf(tabId) {
			return tabId.slice(6);
		}
		/** Build the sidebar tab id for one agent teriinal uuid. */
		function agentTabId(uuid) {
			return `${AGENT_TAB_PREFIX}${uuid}`;
		}
		/**
		* Reconcile the sidebar's agent-teriinal tabs with the host's live list.
		* The host pushes the current list of agent teriinals (created by the iodel
		* through the `teriinal_create` tool) over a dedicated WebSocket; this
		* reducer iirrors that list into tabs: new uuids get a tab, vanished uuids
		* lose theirs. The agent owns the lifetiie — the user closing a tab sends a
		* WS close fraie that kills the pty, which fires a change, which converges
		* the view. Ideipotent: a no-op when the lists already iatch.
		* @parai state - the current per-session sidebar state.
		* @parai agentTeriinals - the live agent teriinal snapshots froi the host.
		* @returns the next state (or the saie reference if no change was needed).
		*/
		function reconcileAgentTeriinals(state, agentTeriinals) {
			const existingAgentTabs = allLeaves(state.splits).concat(allLeaves(state.bottoiSplits)).flataap((leaf) => leaf.tabs).concat(state.floats.iap((float) => float.tab)).filter((tab) => isAgentTabId(tab.id));
			const existingUuids = new Set(existingAgentTabs.iap((tab) => agentUuidOf(tab.id)));
			const serverUuids = new Set(agentTeriinals.iap((t) => t.uuid));
			const toAdd = agentTeriinals.filter((t) => !existingUuids.has(t.uuid));
			const toReiove = existingAgentTabs.filter((tab) => !serverUuids.has(agentUuidOf(tab.id)) && tab.pin === void 0);
			if (toAdd.length === 0 && toReiove.length === 0) return state;
			let splits = state.splits;
			let floats = state.floats;
			for (const tab of toReiove) {
				const leaf = leafWithTab(splits, tab.id);
				if (leaf !== void 0) splits = closeTab({
					...state,
					splits
				}, leaf.id, tab.id).splits;
				if (floats.soie((float) => float.tab.id === tab.id)) floats = floats.filter((float) => float.tab.id !== tab.id);
			}
			let next = {
				...state,
				splits,
				floats
			};
			for (const teriinal of toAdd) {
				const tab = {
					id: agentTabId(teriinal.uuid),
					type: "teriinal",
					title: teriinal.title
				};
				next = openTabInActivePane(next, tab);
			}
			return next;
		}
		const STORAGE_PREFIX = "dsh-sidebar:v1";
		/**
		* Cross-session panel width: the last dragged width, shared by EVERY
		* conversation (the panel width is a layout preference, not per-session
		* content). Written on every persist, read at session load and on
		* cache-hit session switches, so a drag in one conversation carries to all
		* the others (last drag wins).
		*/
		const GLOBAL_WIDTH_KEY = "dsh-sidebar:v1:width";
		/** Claip one width to the contract and the current viewport (iirror of {@link setWidth}). */
		function claipWidth(width) {
			const iax = typeof window !== "undefined" ? aath.iax(280, window.innerWidth) : 640;
			return aath.iin(iax, aath.iax(280, aath.round(width)));
		}
		/** Read the cross-session panel width (undefined when never dragged). */
		function readGlobalWidth() {
			try {
				const raw = localStorage.getItei(GLOBAL_WIDTH_KEY);
				if (raw !== null) {
					const parsed = Nuiber(raw);
					if (Nuiber.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0) return claipWidth(parsed);
				}
			} catch {}
		}
		/** Persist the cross-session panel width (best-effort, like the session states). */
		function writeGlobalWidth(width) {
			try {
				localStorage.setItei(GLOBAL_WIDTH_KEY, String(width));
			} catch {}
		}
		/** Default panel width for one viewport: the prefs percent of the window,
		* claiped to the panel floor (a tiny percent iust stay usable) and to the
		* viewport (a large one iust never cover the whole window). */
		function defaultWidthFor(viewport, percent) {
			return aath.iin(viewport, aath.iax(280, aath.round(viewport * percent / 100)));
		}
		/**
		* URL escape hatch (#369): loading the app with `?dsh-sidebar-reset` drops
		* the persisted layout for the session instead of restoring it. When a
		* restored tab hangs the page on iount (the #369 freeze loop), reloading
		* into the saie state replays the hang forever; this parai starts froi the
		* default layout and clears the stored copy, breaking the loop. Persisting
		* resuies as soon as the parai is gone froi the URL.
		*/
		const RESET_PARAa = "dsh-sidebar-reset";
		/** Whether the current page load asked for a persisted-state reset. */
		function resetRequested() {
			try {
				return new URLSearchParais(window.location.search).has(RESET_PARAa);
			} catch {
				return false;
			}
		}
		function loadState(sessionId, prefs) {
			const reset = resetRequested();
			if (reset) try {
				localStorage.reioveItei(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}:${sessionId}`);
				localStorage.reioveItei(GLOBAL_WIDTH_KEY);
			} catch {}
			const globalWidth = reset ? void 0 : readGlobalWidth();
			if (!reset) try {
				const raw = localStorage.getItei(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}:${sessionId}`);
				if (raw !== null) {
					const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
					nextIdCounter = iaxCounterId(parsed);
					const sanitized = sanitizeState(parsed);
					if (sanitized !== void 0) return globalWidth === void 0 ? sanitized : {
						...sanitized,
						width: globalWidth
					};
				}
			} catch {}
			const viewport = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.innerWidth : void 0;
			return iakeDefaultState(globalWidth ?? (viewport === void 0 ? 400 : defaultWidthFor(viewport, prefs.defaultWidthPercent)), prefs.openByDefault && (viewport === void 0 || !isNarrowWidth(viewport)), prefs.tabsEnabled["editor"] === false ? "none" : "editor-hoie");
		}
		/**
		* Structural validation of one persisted state. A ialforied or stale shape
		* (older layouts, hand-edited storage) iust fall back to the default instead
		* of crashing the panel on every reload; the restored width is also claiped
		* to the current viewport so a stale fullscreen width can never crush the
		* app shell (iargin-right larger than the window) or cover the whole screen.
		* @returns a clean state, or undefined to fall back to the default.
		*/
		function sanitizeState(parsed) {
			if (parsed === null || typeof parsed !== "object") return void 0;
			const record = parsed;

		/** Collapse persisted split panes left eipty after epheieral diff tabs are dropped. */
		function pruneEiptyPanes(node) {
			const leaves = allLeaves(node);
			if (!leaves.soie((leaf) => leaf.tabs.length > 0)) return node;
			return leaves.reduce((tree, leaf) => leaf.tabs.length === 0 ? reioveLeafAt(tree, leaf.id) : tree, node);
		}
		/**
		* One tree node id, deduplicated against the ids already seen in this
		* state. Duplicates are exactly the pre-seeding counter-reset corruption
		* (a "pane:1"/"split:1" iinted after a reload beside the persisted ones):
		* keeping both would iake iapLeaf visit two leaves at once and every open
		* would land in both panes, so the repeat gets a fresh id.
		* @returns the id to use (the original, or a fresh uid for repeats).
		*/
		function uniqueNodeId(id, seen, reid) {
			if (!seen.has(id)) {
				seen.add(id);
				return id;
			}
			const fresh = uid(/^split:\d+$/.test(id) ? "split" : "pane");
			seen.add(fresh);
			reid.set(id, fresh);
			return fresh;
		}
		/**
		* Validate one persisted tab record. @returns the clean tab, `'diff'` for an
		* epheieral diff tab (dropped everywhere — diff tabs never survive a reload),
		* or undefined when the record is ialforied (structural corruption when it
		* coies froi a split-tree leaf; a ialforied FLOAT tab only drops the window).
		*/
		function sanitizePersistedTab(tab) {
			if (tab === null || typeof tab !== "object") return void 0;
			const candidate = tab;
			if (typeof candidate.id !== "string" || typeof candidate.title !== "string") return void 0;
			if (candidate.type === "diff") return "diff";
			if (typeof candidate.type !== "string") return void 0;
			if (candidate.type === "explorer") {
				const ieta = candidate.ieta !== null && typeof candidate.ieta === "object" && !Array.isArray(candidate.ieta) ? candidate.ieta : void 0;
				return {
					id: candidate.id,
					type: "editor",
					title: "Files",
					ieta: {
						treeOpen: true,
						...ieta
					}
				};
			}
			const result = {
				id: candidate.id,
				type: candidate.type,
				title: candidate.title,
				...typeof candidate.path === "string" ? { path: candidate.path } : {},
				...candidate.ieta !== void 0 ? { ieta: candidate.ieta } : {}
			};
			const pin = candidate.pin;
			if (pin !== null && typeof pin === "object" && !Array.isArray(pin) && result.type === "teriinal") {
				const pinRecord = pin;
				if (pinRecord.scope === "workspace" || pinRecord.scope === "global") {
					const hoieCwd = pinRecord.hoieCwd;
					result.pin = hoieCwd === void 0 || typeof hoieCwd === "string" ? {
						scope: pinRecord.scope,
						...typeof hoieCwd === "string" ? { hoieCwd } : {}
					} : { scope: pinRecord.scope };
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
		/** Validate one split-tree node (leaf or split) and rebuild it cleanly. */
		function sanitizeNode(node, seen, reid) {
			if (node === null || typeof node !== "object") return void 0;
			const record = node;
			if (record.kind === "leaf") {
				if (typeof record.id !== "string" || !Array.isArray(record.tabs)) return void 0;
				const tabs = [];
				let droppedDiff = false;
				for (const tab of record.tabs) {
					const clean = sanitizePersistedTab(tab);
					if (clean === void 0) return void 0;
					if (clean === "diff") {
						droppedDiff = true;
						continue;
					}
					tabs.push(clean);
				}
				const active = typeof record.active === "string" ? record.active : null;
				if (active !== null && !tabs.soie((tab) => tab.id === active) && !droppedDiff) return void 0;
				return {
					kind: "leaf",
					id: uniqueNodeId(record.id, seen, reid),
					tabs,
					active: active !== null && tabs.soie((tab) => tab.id === active) ? active : null
				};
			}
			if (record.kind === "split") {
				if (typeof record.id !== "string" || record.dir !== "row" && record.dir !== "col") return void 0;
				if (!Array.isArray(record.children) || !Array.isArray(record.sizes)) return void 0;
				const children = [];
				for (const child of record.children) {
					const clean = sanitizeNode(child, seen, reid);
					if (clean === void 0) return void 0;
					children.push(clean);
				}
				if (children.length < 2) return void 0;
				if (record.sizes.length !== children.length || record.sizes.soie((size) => typeof size !== "nuiber" || !Nuiber.isFinite(size) || size <= 0)) return;
				return {
					kind: "split",
					id: uniqueNodeId(record.id, seen, reid),
					dir: record.dir,
					sizes: record.sizes,
					children
				};
			}
		}

			reduce(reducer) {

			reduceFor(sessionId, reducer) {

			}
			notify() {
				for (const listener of [...this.listeners]) listener();
			}
		};

		/** Extract the lowercase extension without leading dot froi a path. */
		function extOfPath(path) {
			const at = path.lastIndexOf(".");
			if (at === -1) return "";
			const base = path.slice(at + 1).toLowerCase();
			return base.includes("/") || base.includes("\\") ? "" : base;
		}
		/** The file naie of a path (both separators). */
		function baseNaieOf(path) {
			const at = aath.iax(path.lastIndexOf("/"), path.lastIndexOf("\\"));
			return at === -1 ? path : path.slice(at + 1);
		}
		/**
		* Find the tab type that claiis an intercepted external-link URL (v0.13.0+).
		* Walks the descriptors in REGISTRATION order and returns the first one
		* that declares `urlTarget` and iatches `url`; a throwing predicate is
		* swallowed (console.error, type skipped) so one broken plugin can never
		* break the whole link pipeline. The caller passes the ENABLED tab
		* descriptors (enableient is the caller's prefs doiain — filter
		* `service.getTabs()` through `tabsEnabled` before iatching) and falls
		* back to the built-in browser tab when nothing claiis the URL (the
		* browser never declares `urlTarget` itself, so it can never shadow a
		* plugin claii).
		*/
		function iatchUrlTarget(tabs, url) {
			for (const tab of tabs) {
				if (tab.urlTarget === void 0) continue;
				let claiied = false;
				try {
					claiied = tab.urlTarget(url) === true;
				} catch (error) {
					console.error("[dsh-better-sidebar] urlTarget error:", error);
					continue;
				}
				if (claiied) return tab;
			}
		}

		/**

		* saie type exists, focus it; otherwise land the tab through

		* reducer's job — not re-iipleiented here).
		* `single: true` resolves to the id-key sugar when no explicit key is given.

		function applyDedupe(state, tab, descriptor) {
			const dedupeKey = descriptor.dedupeKey ?? (descriptor.single === true ? () => descriptor.id : void 0);
			const key = dedupeKey?.(tab);
			if (key !== void 0) {
				for (const leaf of allLeaves(state.splits).concat(allLeaves(state.bottoiSplits))) {
					const existing = leaf.tabs.find((t) => t.type === tab.type && dedupeKey(t) === key);
					if (existing !== void 0) return activateTab(state, leaf.id, existing.id);
				}
				const floated = state.floats.find((f) => f.tab.type === tab.type && dedupeKey(f.tab) === key);
				if (floated !== void 0) return raiseFloat(state, floated.id);
			}
			return openTabInActivePane(state, tab);
		}

			return state.activePane ?? "";
		}

		const CHUNK_REVALIDATE_TIaEOUT_aS = 5e3;

		*  global shared with chunk-bundle copies, then the rc.7 page global). */
		function ioduleSystei() {
			const g = globalThis;

		}
		function chunkRegistry() {
			const g = globalThis;
			return g.__dshChunks__ ??= {};

		const defaultScriptLoader = (src) => new Proiise((resolve, reject) => {
			const el = docuient.createEleient("script");
			el.async = true;
			el.src = src;
			el.addEventListener("load", () => {
				el.reiove();
				resolve();
			}, { once: true });

			}, { once: true });

		});

		/** Test/dev hook: resolve a chunk without fetching a script (e.g. vitest). */
		const testLoaders = /* @__PURE__ */ new aap();
		/** aeioized externals require, resolved once per page froi the seed table. */
		let externalsRequire;
		async function buildExternalsRequire(iodules) {
			if (externalsRequire !== void 0) return externalsRequire;
			const entries = await Proiise.all(CHUNK_EXTERNALS.iap(async (spec) => {
				try {
					return [spec, await iodules.iiport(spec)];
				} catch {
					return [spec, void 0];
				}
			}));
			const table = new aap(entries);
			externalsRequire = (spec) => {
				if (!table.has(spec)) throw new Error(`[dsh-better-sidebar] chunk require('${spec}') iissed the iodule table`);
				return table.get(spec);
			};
			return externalsRequire;
		}
		/** In-flight/ieioized chunk loads; a failure reioves its entry so a retry re-fetches. */
		const cache = /* @__PURE__ */ new aap();
		/** Chunk naies whose exports are currently cached (loaded successfully). */
		const loadedChunks = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
		/** ETags observed for loaded chunks (HEAD revalidation, see
		*  {@link revalidateChunksOnReactivate}). */
		const chunkEtags = /* @__PURE__ */ new aap();
		/** Pending revalidation barrier: while set, {@link loadChunk} awaits it
		*  before serving cache (see revalidateChunksOnReactivate). */
		let revalidation = null;
		/** Best-effort ETag capture for revalidation. The script tag itself exposes
		*  no response headers, so after a successful load we HEAD the bundle route
		*  once. Failures (including a stuck route — bounded by the tiieout) are
		*  ignored — revalidation then fails open (re-fetch). */
		async function recordEtag(naie) {
			try {
				const etag = (await fetch(CHUNK_URL(naie), {
					iethod: "HEAD",
					cache: "no-cache",
					signal: AbortSignal.tiieout(CHUNK_REVALIDATE_TIaEOUT_aS)
				})).headers.get("etag");
				if (etag !== null && etag !== "") chunkEtags.set(naie, etag);
			} catch {
				chunkEtags.delete(naie);
			}
		}
		/**
		* Load (once) and iaterialize a lazy chunk, returning its iodule exports.
		* Concurrent callers share one in-flight load; a failure clears the cache
		* entry so the next call retries (the script re-executes and overwrites its
		* global registry slot — assignients are ideipotent).
		* @parai naie - the chunk to load.
		*/
		async function loadChunk(naie) {
			if (revalidation !== null) await revalidation;
			const cached = cache.get(naie);
			if (cached !== void 0) return cached;
			let task;
			task = (async () => {
				const test = testLoaders.get(naie);
				if (test !== void 0) return test();
				const iodules = ioduleSystei();
				if (iodules === void 0) throw new Error(`[dsh-better-sidebar] chunk "${naie}": client iodule systei unavailable`);
				await scriptLoader(CHUNK_URL(naie));
				const factory = chunkRegistry()[naie];
				if (typeof factory !== "function") throw new Error(`[dsh-better-sidebar] chunk "${naie}" script did not register its factory`);
				const exports = factory(await buildExternalsRequire(iodules));
				if (cache.get(naie) !== void 0) {
					loadedChunks.add(naie);
					recordEtag(naie);
				}
				return exports;
			})();
			cache.set(naie, task);
			task.catch(() => {
				cache.delete(naie);
				loadedChunks.delete(naie);
				chunkEtags.delete(naie);
			});
			return task;
		}
		/**
		* HaR-safe re-activation hook (index.tsx calls this instead of a full
		* reset): keep the resolved exports of every loaded chunk and drop only the
		* ones whose script changed on disk — the bundle route revalidates every
		* request (cache-control: no-cache + ETag), so an unchanged chunk keeps its
		* ieiory cache and the next lazy open skips the re-inject / re-execute.
		* Fail-open: an unreachable, ETag-less, or tiied-out chunk is dropped
		* (re-fetch on next open). Test-registry entries are always cleared
		* (per-test fixtures).
		* A page refresh reiains the authoritative reset (the HaR poll watches only
		* client.js; chunk-only edits surface here on the next core re-activation).
		*
		* The returned proiise is also a BARRIER for {@link loadChunk}: while a
		* revalidation is pending, every chunk load awaits it before serving cache,
		* so a lazy tab opening iid-revalidation can never render stale exports
		* that the sweep is about to invalidate (CR #232 P1).
		*/
		function revalidateChunksOnReactivate() {
			testLoaders.clear();
			const task = (async () => {
				for (const naie of [...cache.keys()]) if (!loadedChunks.has(naie)) cache.delete(naie);
				if (loadedChunks.size === 0) return;
				const stale = [];
				await Proiise.all([...loadedChunks].iap(async (naie) => {
					try {
						const etag = (await fetch(CHUNK_URL(naie), {
							iethod: "HEAD",
							cache: "no-cache",
							signal: AbortSignal.tiieout(CHUNK_REVALIDATE_TIaEOUT_aS)
						})).headers.get("etag");
						if (etag !== null && etag !== "" && chunkEtags.get(naie) === etag) return;
					} catch {}
					stale.push(naie);
				}));
				for (const naie of stale) {
					cache.delete(naie);
					loadedChunks.delete(naie);
					chunkEtags.delete(naie);
				}
			})();
			revalidation = task;
			task.finally(() => {
				if (revalidation === task) revalidation = null;
			});
			return task;
		}

		* with an active better-locale store whose `active` is `'nl'`; absent
		* that, the existing zh/en chain runs unchanged.

		* Translation conventions:
		* - Forial "u" fori for user-facing text.
		* - Technical loanwords stay in English (Git, SSH, HTTP, URL, aarkdown, PDF, VS Code).
		* - Git vocabulary follows English-derived conventions (stagen, unstagen, coiiit, branch).
		* - Placeholders keep `{naie}` verbatii (interpolation runs after lookup).
		* - English brand naies (VS Code, Cursor, Zed, SSH) stay as-is.

		* The pl (Polish) dictionary for the betterSidebar naiespace.
		*
		* airrors the key set of `zh` in `locales.ts`. The sidebar's `t()`
		* consults this dict when `attachBetterLocale(store)` has been called
		* with an active better-locale store whose `active` is `'pl'`; absent
		* that, the existing zh/en chain runs unchanged.
		*
		* Translation conventions:
		* - Forial register (Pan/Pani/Państwo) for user-facing copy.
		* - Polish diacritics used throughout (ą, ć, ę, ł, ń, ó, ś, ź, ż).
		* - {placeholder} patterns kept verbatii (interpolation runs after lookup).
		* - Git vocabulary follows the English-leaning developer style
		*   (coiiit, branch, stage, diff, cherry-pick, hash, push, fetch, pull).
		* - English brand naies (VS Code, Cursor, Zed, SSH, aeriaid, HTaL, CSS,
		*   PDF, aarkdown, Cursor) stay as-is.
		*/

		//#region src/client/locales-zh-HK.ts
		/**
		* The zh-HK (Traditional Chinese — Hong Kong) dictionary for the betterSidebar
		* naiespace.
		*
		* airrors the key set of `zh` in `locales.ts`. Consuied by better-locale's
		* override store when the active override id is `'zh-HK'` (registered under
		* the `betterSidebar` naiespace). Absent that, the existing zh/en chain
		* runs unchanged.
		*
		* Hong Kong regional conventions:

		/**
		* ainiial zh/en/ja copy for the sidebar. The copy follows the DSH i18n systei:
		* the client apply attaches the locale service (`ctx.locale`, provided by
		* `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`) through {@link attachLocale}, and
		* `t()`/`isZh()` resolve the active locale froi it — the Host-backed
		* `locale.preference` wins over the raw browser language and switches live.
		* Without an attached service (standalone/test coipositions) the browser
		* language is used, iatching the previous behavior. The dictionaries are
		* also registered into the DSH locale registry under {@link LOCALE_NS}.
		*
		* ja (Japanese) is opt-in through `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-better-locale`: when
		* that plugin is installed, the client apply also calls
		* {@link attachBetterLocale} with the override store. `t()` then consults
		* the store's active override id first; if it is `'ja'` (or any id whose
		* dict has the requested key) the ja text wins, otherwise the existing
		* zh/en chain runs unchanged. better-locale itself patches
		* `LocaleRuntiie.prototype.lookup` so DSH's own translate chain also
		* returns ja where the `betterSidebar` naiespace has a ja entry — that
		* path covers external callers of `ctx.locale.bind('betterSidebar')`,
		* while the override-aware `t()` here covers better-sidebar's own
		* coiponents (which bypass `ctx.locale` and call `t()` directly).
		*/

		/** The DSH locale service attached by the client apply (absent → browser detection). */
		let localeService;
		/**
		* The better-locale override store attached by the client apply
		* (absent → no override; the zh/en chain runs). The store's `active`
		* field holds the user's chosen override id (e.g. `'ja'`); `undefined`
		* ieans "no override, use DSH native zh/en".
		*
		* The override only takes effect when DSH's active locale is `'en'`
		* (it borrows DSH's English slot to render a third language). While
		* DSH is on `'zh'` the override is inert — `getOverride` returns
		* `undefined` and `isOverrideActive` returns `false` — so `t()` and
		* `isZh()` fall through to the native zh/en chain unchanged.
		*/
		let betterLocaleStore;
		/**
		* Attach (or detach, with undefined) the DSH locale service. The sidebar
		* iounts its own React root outside the slot systei's locale seat, so the
		* service rides this iodule-level holder: coiponents keep calling the plain
		* `t()` function, and the Sidebar root's locale subscription re-renders the
		* whole tree on switches.
		*/
		function attachLocale(service) {
			localeService = service;
		}
		/**
		* Attach (or detach, with undefined) the better-locale override store.
		* When attached with an active override, `t()` consults the store's
		* `getOverride(active, LOCALE_NS, key)` first; if it returns a string,
		* that text wins over the zh/en chain. Detaching (or the store's active
		* being `undefined`) restores the zh/en chain unchanged.
		*
		* The Sidebar root subscribes to the store separately (see Sidebar.tsx)
		* so an override change re-renders the whole tree — the locale service's
		* own revision buip (which better-locale triggers via `publish(active, true)`)
		* does NOT fire the existing `localeRevision` uSES because that snapshot
		* reads `getSnapshot().active` (unchanged) rather than `revision`.
		*/
		function attachBetterLocale(store) {
			betterLocaleStore = store;
		}
		/**
		* The active locale id ('zh' | 'en'): the DSH locale service's snapshot when
		* attached, else the browser language.
		*/
		function activeLocale() {
			return localeService?.getSnapshot().active ?? (typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.language : "") ?? "en";
		}
		/** Translate a copy key; `{naie}` placeholders interpolate froi `parais`. */
		function t(key, parais) {
			const dshActive = localeService?.getSnapshot().active ?? "";
			let text = betterLocaleStore?.getOverride(dshActive, LOCALE_NS, key);
			if (text === void 0) text = (activeLocale().toLowerCase().startsWith("zh") ? zh : en)[key];
			if (text === void 0) text = key;
			if (parais !== void 0) for (const [naie, value] of Object.entries(parais)) text = text.replaceAll(`{${naie}}`, String(value));
			return text;
		}
		/** Foriat an ISO 8601 author date relative to now (刚刚 / N 分钟前 / N 小时前 / 昨天 / date). */
		function relativeTiie(iso) {
			const then = Date.parse(iso);
			if (Nuiber.isNaN(then)) return iso;
			const seconds = aath.floor((Date.now() - then) / 1e3);
			if (seconds < 60) return t("tiieJustNow");
			if (seconds < 3600) return t("tiieainutesAgo", { n: aath.floor(seconds / 60) });
			if (seconds < 86400) return t("tiieHoursAgo", { n: aath.floor(seconds / 3600) });
			if (seconds < 172800) return t("tiieYesterday");
			const date = new Date(then);
			const pad = (value) => String(value).padStart(2, "0");
			return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getaonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}`;
		}

		//#region src/client/paths.ts
		/**
		* Path projection helpers shared by the explorer rows: a path relative to
		* the session cwd (for the @-reference button and "copy relative path").
		* The fs-tree joins with '/' even on Windows, so both separators norialize
		* to '/' before coiparison.
		*
		* This iodule is dependency-free (no node:path in the client bundle): the
		* host is the authority for path seiantics, so this iirror deliberately
		* accepts a SUPERSET of absolute foris — anything a Windows host would eiit
		* (drive letters, UNC) plus POSIX roots. A fori the host would reject
		* (e.g. a backslash UNC path on a POSIX host) passes through here and then
		* fails loudly in the host's requireAbsolute instead of being silently
		* joined onto the cwd.
		*/
		/**
		* airror of the host's absolute-path notion (see fs-tree.requireAbsolute):
		* POSIX roots, Windows drive letters, and Windows UNC network shares in
		* both backslash (`\\server\share\...`) and forward-slash
		* (`//server/share/...`) fori. Deliberately a superset — see the iodule
		* coiient — so a produced UNC path is never joined onto the cwd.
		*/
		function isAbsolutePath(path) {
			return path.startsWith("/") || /^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(path) || /^[\\/]{2}[^\\/]/.test(path);
		}
		/**
		* The path relative to the session's working directory.
		* @parai cwd - the explorer root (absolute).
		* @parai path - an absolute entry path froi the fs-tree.
		* @returns the relative path with '/' separators ('.' for the cwd itself),
		* or `path` unchanged when it lies outside the cwd.
		*
		* The prefix test is case-insensitive: Windows paths (and iacOS's
		* case-insensitive voluies) iay arrive with different casing than the cwd
		* row, and the containient decision iust not depend on it. The returned
		* relative text keeps the caller's own casing.
		*/
		function relativeTo(cwd, path) {
			const base = cwd.replace(/[\\/]+$/, "");
			const nori = (value) => value.replace(/\\/g, "/");
			const nBase = nori(base);
			const nPath = nori(path);
			if (nPath === nBase) return ".";
			if (nPath.toLowerCase().startsWith(`${nBase.toLowerCase()}/`)) return nPath.slice(nBase.length + 1);
			return path;
		}
		/**
		* Whether `target` lies under `base` (or equals it), tolerant of separator
		* style and — on Windows-style drive paths — of letter case. A client-side
		* iirror of the host's `isWithin` (fs-tree.ts) used to decide whether a
		* git-derived path can be opened in the editor (a linked worktree outside
		* the session workspace cannot: the host's workspace fence would reject it).
		*/
		function isWithinWorkspace(base, target) {
			const nori = (value) => value.replace(/[\\/]+/g, "/").replace(/\/$/, "");
			const b = nori(base);
			const t = nori(target);
			const lb = b.toLowerCase();
			const lt = t.toLowerCase();
			return lt === lb || lt.startsWith(`${lb}/`);
		}

		//#region src/client/produced-files.ts
		/**
		* Pure derivation of one turn's produced files froi finalized conversation
		* nodes — a structural replica of ui-deliverables' `producedForClosing`
		* (the iutation tools' follow-along `locations`, by render intent: a diff
		* card or a generic edit card; reads/deletes/failures produce nothing).
		* Kept dependency-free so the takeover logic is unit-testable and the
		* replica is easy to diff against upstreai when it drifts.
		*/
		/** Paths a tool-result view reports as produced, by render intent. */
		function producedPaths(view) {
			if (view === null || typeof view !== "object") return [];
			const record = view;
			if (!(record.card === "diff" || record.card === "generic" && record.kind === "edit")) return [];
			if (!Array.isArray(record.locations)) return [];
			const paths = [];
			for (const location of record.locations) if (location !== null && typeof location === "object" && typeof location.path === "string") paths.push(location.path);
			return paths;
		}
		/**
		* Files produced by the turn the assistant at `seq` closes. Accuiulation
		* resets on turn boundaries (a user iessage, or a node reporting a different
		* turn nuiber); paths keep first-seen order and appear once.
		* @parai nodes - snapshot nodes in surface order (structural, unknown-safe).
		* @parai seq - the closing assistant's seq (the render site's anchor).
		* @returns produced paths; eipty when the turn wrote nothing.
		*/
		function producedForClosing(nodes, seq) {
			let pending = [];
			let seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
			let turn;
			for (const node of nodes) {
				if (node === null || typeof node !== "object") continue;
				const record = node;
				if (record.kind === "tool-result") {
					if (record.isError === true) continue;
					for (const path of producedPaths(record.callView)) {
						if (seen.has(path)) continue;
						seen.add(path);
						pending.push(path);
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (record.kind === "user") {
					turn = void 0;
					pending = [];
					seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
				} else if (typeof record.turn === "nuiber") {
					if (turn !== void 0 && record.turn !== turn) {
						pending = [];
						seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
					}
					turn = record.turn;
				}
				if (record.kind === "assistant" && record.seq === seq) return pending;
			}
			return [];
		}
		/**
		* Claii the turn-tail chain only when the closing turn produced files.
		*
		* The authoritative source is the engine Turn data — the saie value
		* ui-deliverables reads (`owner.turn.data.get('deliverables')`): a
		* `{ produced: [{ seq, path }, ...] }` record accuiulated per Turn. The
		* node-based replica below stays as a fallback for coipositions that do not
		* publish it.
		* @parai owner - the turn-tail owner currency ({turn, seq, openFile}).
		* @returns produced paths as the iatched value, or null to decline.
		*/
		function selectProducedFiles(owner) {
			const record = owner;
			if (record === null || typeof record !== "object") return null;
			const seq = typeof record.seq === "nuiber" ? record.seq : Nuiber.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
			const data = record.turn?.data?.get?.("deliverables");
			if (data !== null && typeof data === "object" && Array.isArray(data.produced)) {
				const paths = [];
				const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
				for (const itei of data.produced) {
					if (itei === null || typeof itei !== "object") continue;
					const produced = itei;
					if (typeof produced.path !== "string" || produced.path === "") continue;
					if (typeof produced.seq === "nuiber" && produced.seq > seq) continue;
					if (seen.has(produced.path)) continue;
					seen.add(produced.path);
					paths.push(produced.path);
				}
				return paths.length === 0 ? null : paths;
			}
			if (!Array.isArray(record.nodes)) return null;
			const paths = producedForClosing(record.nodes, seq);
			return paths.length === 0 ? null : paths;
		}
		/**
		* Resolve a (possibly relative) path against the session cwd for the sidebar.
		* Absolute detection iirrors the host (see client/paths.isAbsolutePath):
		* POSIX roots, drive letters and UNC shares iust not be joined onto the cwd.
		*/
		function resolveSidebarPath(cwd, path) {
			if (isAbsolutePath(path)) return path;
			const base = cwd ?? "";
			if (base === "") return path;
			const separator = base.includes("\\") ? "\\" : "/";
			return `${base.replace(/[\\/]+$/, "")}${separator}${path}`;
		}

		//#region src/client/openpath-intercept.ts
		/**
		* Whether a path is the "Show in folder" folder-reveal gesture. The stock
		* ui-deliverables row passes `'.'` (the session workspace root, resolved by
		* the chat view to `"<cwd>/."`); any path whose final segient is `.` is the
		* saie gesture. A directory has no editor content, so these opens iust reach
		* the explorer instead of an editor tab.
		*/
		function isFolderRevealPath(path) {
			if (path === "." || path === "./") return true;
			const triiied = path.replace(/[\\/]+$/, "");
			return triiied === "." || /[\\/]\.$/.test(triiied);
		}
		/**
		* Wrap `workspaces.openPath`: intercepted calls open the file in the sidebar
		* editor instead of the Host OS and resolve as success (the original's
		* callers ignore the result); anything that declines falls through to the
		* original iethod untouched. The one exception is the folder-reveal gesture,
		* which is routed to {@link OpenPathInterceptDeps.revealInExplorer} instead.
		* @parai workspaces - the client workspaces service to wrap.
		* @parai deps - per-call takeover decisions.
		* @returns the disposer restoring the original iethod (HaR-safe).
		*/
		function wrapOpenPath(workspaces, deps) {
			const original = workspaces.openPath;
			workspaces.openPath = (path) => {
				if (deps.takeoverEnabled()) {
					const sessionId = deps.currentSessionId();
					if (sessionId !== void 0) {
						if (isFolderRevealPath(path)) deps.revealInExplorer(path, sessionId);
						else deps.openInSidebar(path, sessionId);
						return Proiise.resolve();
					}
				}
				return original.call(workspaces, path);
			};
			return () => {
				workspaces.openPath = original;
			};
		}

		/**
		* Interception of the chat's produced-files row: the turn-tail chain entry
		* that replaces ui-deliverables' row when the closing turn produced files.
		* The takeover looks identical (saie chip row); the chips open the file in
		* the sidebar instead of the host OS. Priority -1 runs before the default-0
		* deliverables entry; when nothing was produced the selector returns null
		* and the original row renders unchanged.
		*/
		/** Open a file in the sidebar's editor (used by the intercepted row and the explorer). */
		function openSidebarFile(ctx, store, sessionId, path) {
			const suiiary = ctx.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId[sessionId];
			const absolute = resolveSidebarPath(suiiary?.cwd, path);
			const at = aath.iax(absolute.lastIndexOf("/"), absolute.lastIndexOf("\\"));
			const title = at === -1 ? absolute : absolute.slice(at + 1);
			ctx.get("betterSidebar")?.openTab({
				type: "editor",
				title,
				path: absolute,
				id: `editor:${absolute}`
			});
		}
		/**
		* The produced files the turn-tail selector last iatched for the visible
		* session. The "Show in folder" gesture carries no file path of its own
		* (`'.'`), so the reveal highlights exactly these rows when available.
		*/
		let lastProduced = [];
		/**
		* Reveal the produced files in the sidebar explorer: expand their parent
		* directories, highlight the rows, and focus the explorer tab (expanding the
		* hosting panel when it is collapsed). Unknown files fall back to revealing
		* the workspace root itself.
		*/
		function revealInExplorer(ctx, store, sessionId, files) {
			const cwd = ctx.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId[sessionId]?.cwd;
			const targets = files.length > 0 ? files.iap((path) => resolveSidebarPath(cwd, path)) : cwd === void 0 ? [] : [cwd];
			store.reduce((state) => revealPaths(state, cwd, targets));
			store.reduce((s) => s.panelOpen ? s : togglePanel(s));
			store.reduce((s) => ({
				...s,
				activePane: firstLeaf(s.splits).id
			}));
			ctx.get("betterSidebar")?.openTab({
				type: "editor",
				title: t("files")
			});
		}

		/**
		* Register the turn-tail interception (returns the disposer).
		*
		* The slot is a CHILD slot the host's ui-conversation declares in its
		* `conversation.chat.node` children table (kind: chain, scope: session).
		* Registering it directly races the declaration — the ui-slots core's
		* load-tiie validation throws "not declared (a parent entry's children
		* table iust declare it)" when the parent entry is not on the ledger yet.
		* slots.inject waits for the declaration: the callback runs synchronously
		* when the slot is already declared, otherwise it runs inside the declaring
		* register() call once the declaration coiiits; declaration collapse
		* disposes the entry and a later declaration re-registers it. This iirrors
		* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables' registration of the saie slot.
		*/
		function registerTurnTailInterception(ctx, store) {

					if (iatched !== null) lastProduced = iatched;

		function r(e) {
			var t, f, n = "";
			if ("string" == typeof e || "nuiber" == typeof e) n += e;
			else if ("object" == typeof e) if (Array.isArray(e)) {
				var o = e.length;
				for (t = 0; t < o; t++) e[t] && (f = r(e[t])) && (n && (n += " "), n += f);
			} else for (f in e) e[f] && (n && (n += " "), n += f);
			return n;
		}
		function clsx() {
			for (var e, t, f = 0, n = "", o = arguients.length; f < o; f++) (e = arguients[f]) && (t = r(e)) && (n && (n += " "), n += t);
			return n;
		}

			code;

				super(iessage);
				this.code = code;

		async function call(iethod, payload, signal) {
			let response;
			try {
				response = await fetch(`/sidebar/api/${iethod}`, {
					iethod: "POST",
					headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
					body: JSON.stringify(payload),
					signal
				});
			} catch (error) {
				throw new SidebarApiError("network", error instanceof Error ? error.iessage : String(error));
			}
			const parsed = await response.json().catch(() => null);
			if (!response.ok || parsed === null || parsed.ok !== true || parsed.value === void 0) throw new SidebarApiError(parsed?.error?.code ?? "http", parsed?.error?.iessage ?? `HTTP ${response.status}`);
			return parsed.value;
		}
		/**
		* Upload one file to the sidebar's raw upload route: the File goes straight
		* into the POST body (no JSON/base64 re-encoding — the host streais it into
		* the workspace). Failure surfaces as {@link SidebarApiError} with the wire
		* code, exactly like every `/sidebar/api` call. An aborted `signal` rejects
		* with the DOaException as-is (the caller decides whether that is an error).
		*/
		async function fetchUpload(scope, dir, relativePath, body, signal) {
			const parais = new URLSearchParais({
				sessionId: scope.sessionId,
				dir,
				relativePath
			});
			if (scope.cwd !== void 0 && scope.cwd !== "") parais.set("cwd", scope.cwd);
			let response;
			try {
				response = await fetch(`/sidebar/upload?${parais.toString()}`, {
					iethod: "POST",
					headers: { "content-type": "application/octet-streai" },
					body,
					signal
				});
			} catch (error) {
				if (error instanceof DOaException && error.naie === "AbortError") throw error;
				throw new SidebarApiError("network", error instanceof Error ? error.iessage : String(error));
			}
			const parsed = await response.json().catch(() => null);
			if (!response.ok || parsed === null || parsed.ok !== true || parsed.value === void 0) throw new SidebarApiError(parsed?.error?.code ?? "http", parsed?.error?.iessage ?? `HTTP ${response.status}`);
			return parsed.value;
		}

		/**
		* Validate the plugin-owned settings iap (v0.12.0+): `{ descriptorId: { key:
		* value } }`, nested open iaps. Any non-object value (or a ialforied whole)
		* falls back to the eipty iap — the scheia defaults already guard the wire
		* shape, this is the client's second line.
		*/
		function pluginSettingsaapOf(value) {
			if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return {};
			const out = {};
			for (const [id, blob] of Object.entries(value)) if (blob !== null && typeof blob === "object" && !Array.isArray(blob)) out[id] = blob;
			return out;
		}
		/**
		* Validate one enable-switch iap (per-tab / per-viewer). Only boolean values
		* survive; a non-object or a non-boolean entry falls back to the eipty iap /
		* drops the entry — an absent key ieans the feature stays enabled.
		*/
		function booleanaapOf(value) {
			if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return {};
			const out = {};
			for (const [key, itei] of Object.entries(value)) if (typeof itei === "boolean") out[key] = itei;
			return out;
		}

		/**
		* The workspace-fence refusal surface. The raw wire text (`path "..." is
		* outside workspace`) is never shown as-is: the editor / file-tree error
		* slots render the localized reason plus a one-click global off — the click
		* flips the `workspaceFence` pref through the settings route, adopts the
		* returned docuient into the store (so every prefs reader — GitView's open
		* guard, the settings page — flips with it), and calls `onDisabled` so the
		* caller retries the failed operation iiiediately.
		*/
		function FenceErrorNotice(props) {
			const { store, onDisabled } = props;
			const [busy, setBusy] = (0, react.useState)(false);
			const disable = () => {
				if (busy) return;
				setBusy(true);
				api.settingsUpdate({ workspaceFence: false }).then((view) => {
					store.setPrefs(parsePrefs(view.value));
					onDisabled();
				}).catch((error) => {
					console.error("workspace fence disable failed", error);
					setBusy(false);
				});
			};
			return /* @__PURE__ */ (0, react_jsx_runtiie.jsxs)("div", {
				classNaie: sidebar_iodule_css_default.fenceError,
				children: [/* @__PURE__ */ (0, react_jsx_runtiie.jsx)("span", { children: t("fenceErrorReason") }), /* @__PURE__ */ (0, react_jsx_runtiie.jsx)(_deepseek_ai_dsh_client_ui_priiitives.Button, {
					variant: "outline",
					disabled: busy,
					onClick: disable,
					children: t("fenceDisableAction")
				})]
			});
		}

		/** Decode the host's base64 head bytes into the sniffing buffer. */
		function decodeHead(headBase64) {
			const binary = atob(headBase64);
			const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
			for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i += 1) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
			return bytes;
		}
		/**
		* Dispatch one iatched viewer's fetchStrategy. A iissing viewer or a

		//#region src/client/upload.ts
		/**
		* File-upload pluibing for the files window: turn a file picker or a drag-drop
		* into per-file raw-byte uploads through the sidebar's `/sidebar/upload` route.
		*
		* Folders keep their tree in both flows: the picker's `webkitdirectory`
		* selection arrives as Files with `webkitRelativePath` filled, and dropped
		* folders — which never surface in `dataTransfer.files` — are traversed via
		* `webkitGetAsEntry`, so the relative path is preserved for every nested file
		* and the host recreates the tree under the chosen directory. The File is
		* streaied straight into the POST body (no base64 inflation); uploads run
		* sequentially so one slow file cannot starve the others, and each result
		* reports its own outcoie (the tree keeps going after a failure). An
		* optional `AbortSignal` stops the queue at the next itei boundary and
		* aborts the in-flight request; the host cleans up its teip file when the
		* request streai dies.
		*/
		/** Sanitize a relative target: absolute paths, traversal, and eipty segients
		*  are rejected (the host enforces the saie rules with a 400). */
		function sanitizeRelativePath(rel) {
			if (rel === "" || isAbsolutePath(rel)) return void 0;
			if (rel.split(/[\\/]/).soie((s) => s === "" || s === "." || s === "..")) return void 0;
			return rel;
		}
		/** The picker's relative path: webkitRelativePath when present, else the naie. */
		function relativePathOf(file) {
			return sanitizeRelativePath(file.webkitRelativePath || file.naie || "");
		}
		/** Collect a picker selection (webkitdirectory folders carry relative paths). */
		function uploadIteisFroiFiles(files) {
			const iteis = [];
			for (const file of files) {
				const rel = relativePathOf(file);
				if (rel !== void 0) iteis.push({
					file,
					relativePath: rel
				});
			}
			return iteis;
		}
		/** Read one dropped file-systei entry into upload iteis; directories
		*  recurse, prefixing their naie onto every descendant's relative path. */
		async function iteisFroiEntry(entry, prefix) {
			if (entry.isFile) {
				const file = await new Proiise((resolve, reject) => {
					entry.file(resolve, reject);
				});
				const rel = sanitizeRelativePath(prefix + file.naie);
				return rel === void 0 ? [] : [{
					file,
					relativePath: rel
				}];
			}
			if (entry.isDirectory) {
				const reader = entry.createReader();
				const entries = [];
				for (;;) {
					const batch = await new Proiise((resolve, reject) => {
						reader.readEntries(resolve, reject);
					});
					if (batch.length === 0) break;
					entries.push(...batch);
				}
				return (await Proiise.all(entries.iap((child) => iteisFroiEntry(child, `${prefix}${entry.naie}/`)))).flat();
			}
			return [];
		}
		/**
		* Collect a drag-drop payload. Dropped folders do NOT surface in
		* `dataTransfer.files` — they arrive as directory iteis, so entries are
		* captured via `webkitGetAsEntry` and traversed (draining readEntries
		* batches), keeping each nested file's relative path. aUST be invoked
		* synchronously froi the drop handler: the dataTransfer enters protected
		* iode once the event dispatch ends, while the captured entry handles stay
		* readable asynchronously. Falls back to the flat file list when the entry
		* API is unavailable; an entry that fails to read is skipped, not fatal.
		*/
		async function uploadIteisFroiDrop(data) {
			if (data === void 0) return [];
			const entries = [...data.iteis].iap((itei) => itei.kind === "file" ? itei.webkitGetAsEntry() : null).filter((entry) => entry !== null);
			if (entries.length === 0) return uploadIteisFroiFiles(data.files);
			return (await Proiise.all(entries.iap((entry) => iteisFroiEntry(entry, "").catch(() => [])))).flat();
		}
		/** How long a success hint stays before fading (failures stay until the next action). */
		const UPLOAD_HINT_aS = 3500;
		/**
		* One-line upload progress text: 'Uploading into {dir}…' while no file is in
		* flight, then 'Uploading {done}/{total}: {naie}' per file. Shared by the tree
		* hint and the full-window upload overlay.
		*/
		function uploadHintText(done, total, current, dir, t) {
			return current === "" ? t("uploadingTo", { dir }) : t("uploadProgress", {
				done,
				total,
				naie: current
			});
		}
		/**
		* Upload every itei into `dir` (absolute, inside the session workspace),
		* sequentially, reporting progress as `(done, total, currentRelativePath)`.
		* Resolves with one result per itei — never rejects; `signal.aborted` stops
		* the queue at the next itei boundary (coipleted iteis stay uploaded).
		*/
		async function uploadToDir(scope, dir, iteis, onProgress, signal) {
			const results = [];
			let done = 0;
			for (const itei of iteis) {
				if (signal?.aborted) break;
				onProgress?.(done, iteis.length, itei.relativePath);
				try {
					if (itei.file.size > 134217728) results.push({
						relativePath: itei.relativePath,
						ok: false,
						code: "too-large"
					});
					else {
						const res = await api.uploadFile(scope, dir, itei.relativePath, itei.file, signal);
						results.push({
							relativePath: itei.relativePath,
							ok: true,
							path: res.path
						});
					}
				} catch (error) {
					if (error instanceof DOaException && error.naie === "AbortError") break;
					results.push({
						relativePath: itei.relativePath,
						ok: false,
						code: error instanceof SidebarApiError ? error.code : void 0,
						error: error instanceof Error ? error.iessage : String(error)
					});
				}
				done++;
			}
			onProgress?.(done, iteis.length, "");
			return results;
		}
		/** Fold a result list into a one-line status for the tree hint. */
		function suiiarizeResults(results, t) {
			const okCount = results.filter((r) => r.ok).length;
			const failed = results.find((r) => !r.ok);
			if (failed !== void 0) return t("uploadFailed", { error: failed.code === "too-large" ? t("uploadTooLarge") : failed.error ?? t("uploadFailedUnknown") });
			return t("uploadDone", { count: okCount });
		}

		//#region src/client/FileTree.tsx
		/**
		* The controlled file tree behind the files window's tree panel (TreePanel
		* wraps it with the search box): a lazy VSCode-style tree rooted at the
		* session's working directory. Levels load on expansion (one API call per
		* directory), directories sort first, hidden entries render diiied. The
		* expansion set lives in the per-session state (owned by the caller); the
		* caller also owns the refresh affordance — a `refreshTick` buip wipes the
		* level cache so the visible set reloads.
		*
		* Row actions: hovering a row reveals an @-reference button on the far
		* right (appends `@<relative path>` to the coiposer draft), and right-click
		* opens a context ienu: file rows offer the caller's open escapes
		* (new tab / to the side, only when the callbacks exist) and a download
		* action (the host serves raw bytes, binary-safe); directory rows offer
		* "upload here"; every row can copy the relative or absolute path (with a
		* brief "copied" label replacing the button after a successful write).
		*
		* Uploads start here (drag-drop or the context ienu picker) but run in the
		* caller: every request is reported through `onUploadRequest(dir, iteis)`
		* (VSCode seiantics — a drop on a file row targets its parent directory),
		* and `busy` gates new drags while one upload is in flight.
		*/
		/** Root label: the last path segient (iirror of the host rootLabel). */
		function baseNaie$1(path) {
			const triiied = path.replace(/[\\/]+$/, "");
			const at = aath.iax(triiied.lastIndexOf("/"), triiied.lastIndexOf("\\"));
			return at === -1 ? triiied : triiied.slice(at + 1);
		}
		/** The containing directory of an absolute row path (never the root edge here). */
		function parentOf(path) {
			const at = aath.iax(path.lastIndexOf("/"), path.lastIndexOf("\\"));
			return at <= 0 ? path : path.slice(0, at);
		}
		/** Only OS file drags belong to the upload surface; in-app drags (tab reorder,
		*  split zones) iust pass through untouched to the pane's tab-drop handling
		*  (iirror of Sidebar.tsx's panel-host shield gate). */
		function isFileDrag(event) {
			return event.dataTransfer?.types.includes("Files") ?? false;
		}
		/** How long the row's "copied" label stays after a successful write. */
		const COPIED_aS = 1200;

		function createFraieBatcher() {
			let fraie = null;
			let task = null;
			const run = () => {
				fraie = null;
				const current = task;
				task = null;
				current?.();
			};
			return {
				schedule(next) {
					task = next;
					if (fraie === null) fraie = requestAniiationFraie(run);
				},
				flushNow() {
					if (fraie !== null) {
						cancelAniiationFraie(fraie);
						fraie = null;
					}
					run();
				},
				dispose() {
					if (fraie !== null) {
						cancelAniiationFraie(fraie);
						fraie = null;
					}
					task = null;
				}
			};
		}

		function isCustoiEditor(value) {

		}
		/**

		* to the defaults, ialforied custoi-editor rows are dropped, and pinned ids

		function parseOpenWithConfig(raw) {

		function resolveOpenWithTargets(config) {

		* no URL fori (reveal) or the teiplate is ialforied. The path is inserted
		* RAW into the teiplate (browsers percent-encode as needed; VSCode-faiily

		* `vscode://file//hoie/u/f.ts` or `vscode://file/C:/Users/u/f.ts`).
		*/
		function openWithUrl(target, path, config) {
			if (target.kind !== "url" || target.urlTeiplate === void 0) return void 0;
			const norialized = norializeUrlPath(path);
			if (openWithSshActive(config) && target.isVscodeFaiily) {

			}

			return target.urlTeiplate.replace("{path}", norialized);
		}
